PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, hashlib
from collections import Counter
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit, unquote
base_commit = '46c874671c6d066292750401d75af50136ef95d6'
root = pathlib.Path('docs/workstreams/research/AF-RES-002')
docs = {n: json.loads((root/'evidence'/f'{n}.json').read_text()) for n in ('methods','p1','p2')}
sources = [s for d in docs.values() for s in d['sources']]
queries = [q for d in docs.values() for q in d['queries']]
sids = {s['id'] for s in sources}
qids = {q['id'] for q in queries}
assert len(sids) == len(sources) and len(qids) == len(queries), 'duplicate IDs'
required = ('id','url','checked_at_utc','level','locator','version','observed','limitations','read_status')
missing = [(s['id'], k) for s in sources for k in required if not s.get(k)]
assert not missing, missing
def norm(url):
    p = urlsplit(url)
    assert p.scheme in ('http','https'), url
    return urlunsplit((p.scheme.lower(), p.netloc.lower(), p.path.rstrip('/'), p.query, ''))
opened = [s for s in sources if s['read_status'] == 'opened']
opened_urls = [norm(s['url']) for s in opened]
assert len(opened_urls) == len(set(opened_urls)), 'duplicate opened URLs'
abstract_only = {'P2-S14'}
section_reads = [s for s in opened if s['id'] not in abstract_only]
assert len(section_reads) >= 20, 'fewer than 20 substantive source reads'
assert all(s['level'] in ('D1','D2') for s in opened), 'opened source incorrectly graded'
assert all(re.search(r'/blob/[0-9a-f]{40}/', s['url']) for s in opened if s['level']=='D2'), 'unpinned D2 code'
refs = []
def walk(x):
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        for k,v in x.items():
            if k == 'source_id' or k.endswith('source_ids'):
                refs.extend(('S',z) for z in ([v] if isinstance(v,str) else v))
            if k == 'query_id' or k.endswith('query_ids'):
                refs.extend(('Q',z) for z in ([v] if isinstance(v,str) else v))
            walk(v)
    elif isinstance(x,list):
        for v in x: walk(v)
walk(docs)
invalid = [(kind,z) for kind,z in refs if z not in (sids if kind=='S' else qids)]
assert not invalid, invalid
unknown_text_ids = set(re.findall(r'\b(?:M|P1|P2)-[SQ]\d{2}\b',json.dumps(docs))) - sids - qids
assert not unknown_text_ids, sorted(unknown_text_ids)
assert not sids - {z for k,z in refs if k=='S'}, 'unlinked sources'
missing_targets = []
checked_links = 0
for p in root.rglob('*.md'):
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith(('mailto:','#')): continue
        path = unquote(target.split('#')[0])
        if not path: continue
        checked_links += 1
        if not (p.parent/path).exists(): missing_targets.append((str(p),target))
assert not missing_targets, missing_targets
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],text=True).strip()
changed = set(filter(None, git('diff','--name-only',base_commit).splitlines()))
changed.update(filter(None,git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines()))
outside = sorted(p for p in changed if not p.startswith(str(root)+'/'))
assert not outside, outside
assert git('branch','--show-current') == 'work/research-af-res-002'
assert not git('diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=U'), 'merge conflicts'
control='docs/automation/dot-control.json'
control_before=git('rev-parse',base_commit+':'+control)
control_working=git('hash-object',control)
assert control_before == control_working, 'dot-control changed'
review = json.loads((root/'evidence/review.json').read_text())
assert review['status'] == 'complete', 'review not complete'
review_mismatches = [x['path'] for x in review['reviewed_files'] if hashlib.sha256((root/x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != x['sha256']]
assert not review_mismatches, review_mismatches
hashes={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name not in ('VERIFICATION.json','HANDOFF.md')}
report={
 'status':'passed','checked_out_commit':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
 'source_records':len(sources),'unique_source_urls':len({norm(s['url']) for s in sources}),
 'opened_unique_sources':len(opened),'document_or_code_section_reads':len(section_reads),
 'abstract_only_source_ids':sorted(abstract_only),'blocked_sources':[s['id'] for s in sources if s['read_status']!='opened'],
 'opened_levels':dict(Counter(s['level'] for s in opened)),
 'query_records':len(queries),'unique_query_strings_including_rejected_attempt':len({q['q'] for q in queries}),
 'source_reference_edges':sum(k=='S' for k,z in refs),'query_reference_edges':sum(k=='Q' for k,z in refs),
 'invalid_references':invalid,'review_target_hashes_checked':len(review['reviewed_files']),'review_hash_mismatches':review_mismatches,'checked_relative_link_targets':checked_links,'missing_relative_link_targets':missing_targets,
 'outside_paths':outside,'changed_paths':sorted(changed),'dot_control_blob_unchanged':control_before,
 'content_sha256':hashes,
 'limits':['Internal consistency and path audit only; not source truth or product execution verification.',
           'Relative file targets checked; Markdown heading anchors and remote URL availability are not checked.',
           'HANDOFF.md and this report are excluded from content hashes to avoid self-reference.']
}
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
